ModelValidatorExternal.release_notes:
### Project Data Protection

- **New: Confidential data is masked before anything reaches an AI.** Project name, folders, case and model files, vendor/user-defined models (for example the PPC in use), bus names, your Windows user and machine name are replaced with placeholders in everything sent to an AI: your messages, every AI feature's request, every result the AI reads through Model Validator's tools, and plot pictures. Answers come back with the real names. Numbers, bus numbers and standard library models (REGCA1, REECA1, …) are sent as they are. This applies to every AI connection and to external AI clients attached to Model Validator.
- **New: File paths outside the project are hidden.** A path to a file on another drive or a network share (a loose result file, a document) is replaced whole, folder and file names included, also when no project is open. Paths inside the project keep their structure so the AI can still point to project files.
- **New: Plot pictures.** The AI receives its own copy of a plot with every title, legend and label masked; your copy keeps the real names.
- **New: File > Project Data Protection.** Lists what was found in the project and lets you add your own confidential terms: client, technology, vendor, site.
- **New: Nothing is sent when protection can't be applied.** If the confidential terms can't be prepared, the AI request is not sent.
- **New: Outbound record.** Each send to an AI is recorded locally (time, destination, size, what was masked), never its content.
- **New: Document downloads.** The AI won't fetch a link that contains a confidential term.
- **New: Chat links.** A link in the AI chat that contains a confidential term doesn't open in the browser.
- **Improved: AI CLIs.** Claude Code and Codex now run from a working folder outside your user profile and every project, so neither your Windows user name nor a project path reaches the AI that way. Stopping a turn now ends the CLI completely, including on npm-installed versions.

### Internet Access

- **New: File > Internet Access.** Uncheck it and Model Validator makes no network connection at all: no AI, no collaboration server, no update check, no document download, no usage report, no git push/pull. Turning it off stops a running AI turn and closes the collaboration session. The choice is kept across restarts; the status bar shows **Internet: Off**. Simulations and sign-in are not affected.
- **Improved: Allowed destinations.** While online, Model Validator connects only to this PC, the local network, the configured AI provider, your collaboration server and the update check.
